email.email_changed.body:
Someone asked to change the email address of the account {{.username}} to {{.new_email}}. The new address takes effect once it is confirmed from the email sent to it.

If you didn't ask for this, change your password right away.
email.email_changed.subject: The email address of your Maki account is changing
email.email_verify.body:
Confirm that {{.email}} is the email address of the account {{.username}}. The link below works for {{.hours}} hours.

If you didn't add this address, ignore this email.
email.email_verify.subject: Confirm the email address of your Maki account
email.footer: This email was sent automatically by Maki. Please don't reply to it.
email.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
email.password_changed.body:
The password of the account {{.username}} was just changed, and every other device signed in with it has been signed out.

If you didn't change it, choose a new password right away with Forgot password on the Maki sign-in page.
email.password_changed.subject: Your Maki password was changed
email.password_reset.body:
Someone asked to change the password of the account {{.username}}. The link below works for {{.minutes}} minutes, and only once.

If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Your password hasn't changed.
email.password_reset.subject: Choose a new password for your Maki account
error.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact your Manager or the Owner.
error.area_name_taken: Another area in this outlet has this name.
error.area_not_empty: This area still holds {{.tables}} tables. Move or delete them first.
error.areas_changed: The areas changed since the page was opened. Reload, then put them in order again.
error.categories_changed: The categories changed since the page was opened. Reload, then put them in order again.
error.category_in_use: This category still holds {{.menus}} menus. Move or delete them first.
error.category_name_taken: Another category of this outlet has this name.
error.device_already_active: This device is already one of this outlet's cashiers.
error.device_not_found: This device isn't one of this outlet's.
error.device_not_registered: This device isn't registered as one of this outlet's cashiers. Ask a Manager to sign in on it and activate it.
error.device_revoked: This device was revoked, so it can't sell. Ask a Manager to activate it again.
error.dine_in_mode_changed: How this outlet seats its dine-in customers changed: at tables, or by number stands. Reload the menu, then charge again.
error.email_unchanged: That's already your account's email address.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
error.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.layout_changed: This area's layout or tables changed since the editor was opened. Reload the layout, then arrange it again.
error.manager_account: Only the Owner creates and changes Manager accounts.
error.menu_sku_taken: Another menu of this outlet has this SKU.
error.menu_unavailable: Some menus in this order are no longer on sale. Reload the menu, then check the order.
error.method_not_allowed: This method is not allowed on this endpoint.
error.not_ready: The service is not ready yet. Try again shortly.
error.order_id_conflict: Another transaction already has this ID. Start the order again.
error.order_no_taken: This receipt number is already used. The cashier takes the next one and sends the order again.
error.order_not_found: This transaction isn't in this outlet.
error.order_stock_insufficient: Some menus in this order don't have enough stock left. Reload the menu, then check the order.
error.outlet_active: Deactivate this outlet before you delete it.
error.outlet_code_locked: This outlet already has transactions, so its code can't change: every receipt number carries it.
error.outlet_code_taken: This outlet code is taken. The code of a deleted outlet can't be used again either.
error.outlet_inactive: Your outlet is deactivated. Contact the Owner.
error.outlet_name_mismatch: The name you typed isn't the outlet's name.
error.outlet_not_found: This outlet doesn't exist, or you can't open it.
error.own_account: You can't change your own account here. Use your profile.
error.owner_manages_managers: The Owner manages Manager accounts. Staff accounts are their outlet's Managers' job.
error.password_change_required: Change your password before you continue.
error.password_same_as_username: The password can't be the same as the username.
error.password_too_long: The password can have at most {{.max}} characters.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least {{.min}} characters.
error.payload_too_large: The request body is too large.
error.payment_method_unavailable: This outlet doesn't take this payment method.
error.permission_not_held: You can't give a permission you don't have yourself.
error.prices_changed: Some prices changed. Reload the menu, then check the order before charging.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.refresh_superseded: The session was just renewed. Try again.
error.role_in_use: This role is still in use. Move its users to another role first.
error.role_name_taken: Another role of this outlet has this name.
error.schedule_closed: This schedule is finished or cancelled, so it can't change any more.
error.schedule_overlaps: This schedule overlaps another at the same tables. Save it anyway if that is intended.
error.stock_not_tracked: This menu's stock isn't tracked. Turn stock tracking on in the menu form first.
error.table_name_taken: Another table in this outlet has this name.
error.table_occupied: Customers are seated at this table. Release it first.
error.table_unavailable: This table can't be chosen now.
error.token_invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
error.total_changed: The total changed, as the tax, the service charge or the voucher did. Reload the menu, then check the total before charging.
error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.user_not_found: This user isn't in this outlet.
error.username_taken: This username is taken. The username of a deleted user can't be used again either.
error.voucher_code_taken: Another voucher has this code. The code of a deleted voucher can be used again.
error.voucher_min_spend: This order is below the voucher's minimum spend.
error.voucher_not_for_outlet: This voucher isn't valid at this outlet.
error.voucher_not_found: There's no voucher with this code.
error.voucher_used: This voucher has been used, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
error.voucher_used_up: This voucher has been used up.
